requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

3497-4399-4518--228.easyPrerequisites: You've gained at least 1 life this turn.
3497-4399-4518--228.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Ezzaroot Channeler.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3497-4399-4518--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1981-2415-5708-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1424-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least four counters on it.
1424-4687-5479.description:
Activate Presence of Gond by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte three times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping three lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {2}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

3525-3590-6006.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it, adding {U}.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

851-2557-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3532-4668-5078-7864.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-5078-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7828-7832.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7828-7832.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is modified

4091-5845-7791.description:
Activate Orochi Merge-Keeper by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6633-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-6633-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6633-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

2034-3168-4871-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Urza's Incubator.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-2112-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2034-2112-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2457-4094-4289-4478.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

4871-5220-5651-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5651-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1849-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
1849-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

969-3457-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2203-2366-4927-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-4927-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

129-3995-5268.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-3995-5268.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

147-313-997.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-313-997.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Corpse Dance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3180-5220-6900.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Chamber Sentry from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1887-4321-4636-5770.description:
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token and a Food token.
When the Beast and Food enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get eight {E}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

5299-5921-5970-6791--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
5299-5921-5970-6791--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
5299-5921-5970-6791--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

uses.exileCardState: with a memory counter on it

3951-5703-6646-6753.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-5703-6646-6753.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

5670-6291-6719.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6291-6719.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2558-4186-5315-6701.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.
2558-4186-5315-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3228-5295-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

1399-1606-1671-4452.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

710-997-1258.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

985-5078-5864-6055.notablePrerequisites: Poison Dart Frog does not have summoning sickness.
985-5078-5864-6055.description:
Activate Poison Dart Frog's first ability by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

1741-3756-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1741-3756-5900.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Izzet Boilerworks and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.

792-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
792-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

7-376-678-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional non-Human creature.
You control at least two creatures with +1/+1 counters on them, excluding the additional non-Human creature.
7-376-678-4050.description:
Cast Cubwarden for its mutate cost by paying {W}{W}, targeting a non-Human creature you control.
The Cubwarden mutated creature triggers, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cubwarden mutated creature, adding {W}.
When the Cubwarden mutated creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Cubwarden and any cards merged with it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Cat token, adding {W}.
Repeat.

91-1242-5112-5284.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
91-1242-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

2645-3512-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five mana-producing lands.
2645-3512-4657.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Mana Flare triggers five times, adding at least {5}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

215-2469-2661-4893.notablePrerequisites: Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
215-2469-2661-4893.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying {1}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Phyrexian Dreadnought enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {G}, returning Phyrexian Dreadnought from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Phyrexian Dreadnought ability, failing to sacrifice it due to it no longer being on the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4936.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4050-4936.description:
Cause a token to enter the battlefield under your control.
The token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloakwood Swarmkeeper, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cloakwood Swarmkeeper.
Animation Module triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

69-2182-3858.description:
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Dark Depths.
Thespian's Stage triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and create a 20/20 Marit Lage legendary creature token.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

337-776-1329-3696.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
337-776-1329-3696.description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Bone Saw to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Bone Saw.
Cast Bone Saw.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
